notes.title: New Player Experience
notes.notes: [p]This patch marks a major milestone for the game, bringing some of our biggest changes yet. We’ve overhauled the new player experience by eliminating base roles, introducing Alchemy earlier, and weaving in more class fantasy so every character feels unique from the start. We’re also celebrating our third anniversary of being live with a host of improvements, fixes, and quality-of-life updates to make the game better than ever.[/p][p][/p][h2]3 Year Anniversary[/h2][p]Next month we will be celebrating our third anniversary of being live! That means we are spinning up our usual seasonals:[/p][list][*][p]Ichabod has returned to Newhaven City with new goodies![/p][/*][*][p]Enabled seasonal scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Turnip heads can now drop from humanoid enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Humanoid enemies may now occasionally equip turnip heads.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Player Experience[/h2][h3]Ember Stones & Alchemy[/h3][p]We want to bring the excitement of Alchemy, the bizarre nature of Ember, and the Ember Veins closer to the start of the game, giving players an early taste of our unique fantasy elements.[/p][list][*][p]Alchemy quest can now be obtained and completed starting at level 1.[/p][list][*][p]Added a new tutorial popup upon unlocking Alchemy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ember Stones are now obtained during the Alchemy unlock quest. [/p][list][*][p]Added a new tutorial popup upon the acquisition of an Ember Stone.[/p][/*][*][p]Previous quest elements in Meadowlands (including Archie) have been disabled.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Base Role & Specialization -> Class[/h3][p]We want each class’s flavor to come through immediately, reducing reliance on generic role abilities so that every character feels and looks unique from the start. To work towards that goal a number of generic role abilities have been replaced with more thematic class abilities:[/p][list][*][p]Bleeding Strike for Strikers has been replaced by:[/p][list][*][p]Berserkers gain a new ability "Impact" which is a slow but inexpensive 2x weapon damage attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Brigands gain a new ability "Shifting Strike" which in addition to dealing damage, gives the Brigand a strong +Positional buff for a period of time or after 2 ability uses.[/p][/*][*][p]Wardens gain a new ability "Snare" which in addition to dealing damage slows their target's movement.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Assailing Strike for Supporters (except Duelist) has been replaced by:[/p][list][*][p]Duelists keep Assailing Strike making armor damage core to their offensive style.[/p][/*][*][p]Warlords gain a new ability "Dread Tone" which deals damage, armor damage and reduces the target's outgoing damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinels again a new ability "Guarding Strike" which deals damage, armor damage, and reduces damage to themselves[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Threatening Strike for Defenders (except Marshal) has been replaced by...[/p][list][*][p]Marshals keep Threatening Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Knights gain two new abilities: "Order of Iron" that deals additional damage on each autoattack and "Order of the Tribune" that generates additional threat on each autoattack.[/p][/*][*][p]Juggernauts gain a new ability "Momentum" which deals damage and gives a stacking +dmg buff, this buff stacks up to 5 times.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]In addition to the skill replacements above, many skills have been brought down to lower levels changing which abilities classes start with. Everyone gets "Strike" and the following:[/p][list][*][p]Berserker starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Impact[/p][/*][*][p]Assault[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Brigand starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Shifting Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Stun[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Warden starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Venom Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Quillback Spines[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Duelist starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Combined Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Assailing Strike[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Warlord starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Dread Tone[/p][/*][*][p]Rejuvenating Hymn[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sentinel starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Blinding Strike (previously named Distracting Strike)[/p][/*][*][p]Restoration (previously named Replenish)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Juggernaut starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Momentum[/p][/*][*][p]Breach[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Knight starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Enraging Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Order of Iron[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Marshal starts with:[/p][list][*][p]Threatening Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Halt[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Other miscellaneous changes worth noting:[/p][list][*][p][b]You can no longer forget an adventuring role, spec, or class. To play a different class you must use a different character.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]New characters now start with different equipped weapons and armor based on selected class.[/p][/*][*][p]Various theming elements of each class have been adjusted, such as icons and descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Players must select a portrait at character creation.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled Ally the trainer in Newhaven City. She has finally earned enough to retire.[/p][/*][*][p]Juggernaut's Breach Alchemy descriptions no longer mention "Momentum" to avoid confusion with their new skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinels have had three of their abilities renamed to focus on a stronger theme and class identity:[/p][list][*][p]Replenish -> Restoration[/p][/*][*][p]Distracting Strike -> Blinding Strike[/p][/*][*][p]Overprovision -> Night Watch[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional Balance changes:[/p][list][*][p]Increased damage on Halt, Halt by default no longer disables auto attack, Halt now also has additional hit triggers before being removed by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Juggernaut Roar base ability no longer gives a +dmg increase (this has moved into Momentum).[/p][/*][*][p]Warden Assist has moved up to level 30 in order to bring Quillback Spines down to a lower level.[/p][list][*][p]Assist now grants the entire group Advantage for a duration instead of just your defensive target.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sentinel now gets an additional 5 Armor Weight starting at level 1[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Current Characters[/h3][list][*][p]Characters without a base role or specialization will be required to select a class before they can enter the game. A new button "Select Class" will show on the character nameplate, which will show a new dialog with your selection options (this choice is FINAL and cannot be reverted).[/p][list][*][p]With no base class you can select from all 9 available classes and will start at level 1.[/p][/*][*][p]With a base role but no spec you will be able to choose from the 3 subclasses of your base role. If you are below level 6 then your class level will match your current level. If you are above level 6, then your class level will be set to level 6 and will need to play catch up.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All other characters will undergo a "live migration" process on their first zone in which will add, remove, and replace skills depending on your specific class configuration.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Newhaven Valley Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Most camps have been reduced to 1^ in difficulty. The Ancient Bear camp remains 3^.[/p][/*][*][p]Regular named mobs have been reduced to 2^ difficulty (rewards are unchanged). This excludes Misha and Knave of Harts.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased respawn rate of cave bears.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased frequency of Frenzied mobs near the newbie area.[/p][/*][*][p]Wayward Mangrove has been brought closer to the newbie area, while it is non-aggressive it does assist the Mandrakes if you are not mindful.[/p][/*][*][p]The Crawling Burrows Ember Vein has been moved from Dryfoot to Newhaven Valley. The content and rewards within have been updated to reflect the lower level (~lvl 5).[/p][list][*][p]Added a new tutorial popup describing Ember Veins upon entering the Crawling Burrows.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added well travelled roads to the main thoroughfare (just past the newbie camp).[/p][/*][*][p]Beardin now accepts any type of diseased hide.[/p][/*][*][p]Johan's intro kill quest has been removed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Ibaxus Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing Ibaxian Recipe chests from spawning in Central Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing stats on Central Ibaxus Juggernaut Curved Sword Relic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Movement Resists were being added twice for Ibixian Adornment outer armor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue while shaping Central Ibaxian Relics that was causing the wrong Relic to be considered for setting Class Requirements to equip.[/p][/*][*][p]Central Ibaxus Shaped Relics should more consistently inherit stats from the supplied Lower Ibaxus Shaped Relics.[/p][/*][*][p]Crusader Arribac's allies no longer share a respawn timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Disciples of Ruto in Ibaxus have had their Energy Leech ability reduced and the self-haste component removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Central Ibaxus weapons (Greater Ibaxian Relics) to have enhanced emissions.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced potency of abilities from Corduun Seekers and Excavators.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Daze duration on Ibaxian Slagjacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Ibaxian Adornment Outer Armor pieces now consider all resist runes to give their full effect[/p][/*][*][p]Added new NPC reset tech that restricts mobs to a defined volume. Mobs will reset if [b]they or their targets[/b] leave the volume, and they will ignore incoming damage from players outside of it (will show as avoid). This system was applied to Ibaxian encounters meant to be fought in specific areas, such as Arribac (+allies), Morte (+allies), and his Jailers (+allies).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added VFX to player teleports (see gif below).[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX to Other's disappearances (see gif below).[/p][/*][*][p]Added VFX for Ashen spawns & deaths.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a context menu option to character select buttons to remove characters from the Ember Ring visually on selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to disable visuals for adornment layers. This is available via context menu on the adornment layer tab within the equipment UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Added toggle to the gameplay options to enable/disable world boss death announcements.[/p][/*][*][p]World boss death announcements are now shown in the emotes channel.[/p][/*][*][p]Marta is now selling items from her fall lineup.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage over time should now show damage types in the combat log tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled the depth-of-field effect on character selection. Hopefully this gives your GPU a little break.[/p][/*][*][p]Player Damage Resists now impact damage over time abilities per-tick damage calculations.[/p][/*][*][p]Meadowlands Lake Brown Bears have been reduce to 1^ difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced respawn rate in Grimstone Canyon fishing village and Stonecoat camp.[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting intro quest should now be a bit more resilient (back end improvements).[/p][/*][*][p]GEL now uses the player's actual level for XP calculations against yellow and lower mobs (actual chevron color), while orange and red mobs use the GEL level (GEL icon color). This provides "the best of both worlds", combining the old method with the newer one.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/e6dbdad5fec2c1d96d604f78455c35b29b383af7.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/5e40b87693dedb0747527bb86e030dce4ee81fc7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed stuck spots in Grizzled Peaks, Ibaxus, Grimstone Canyon, and Highland Hills.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spelling errors in Watchful Other and Ageta dialogs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing tooltip on the Login with Steam button when Steam fails to initialize.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the macro bar not considering the bottom buttons as part of the window. In other words: they can no longer be pushed off screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an incorrect death broadcast from Wolf Wildfire in Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could prevent the finalization of a subscription purchase through Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause abilities to swap places in the skills UI when they were swapped on the action bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause duplicate scenes to load from character selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with default chat settings not being present.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Noble Elk recipes incorrectly requiring level 25.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple player ability animations that could fail to play.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typo on Hardtack.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Monthly Patch: August 2025
notes.notes: [p]This month's patch has a number of QoL improvements, bug fixes, and design adjustments. [/p][p]IL2CPP is now the default build configuration (detailed [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3336530/partnerevents/edit/510712822654566617"]here[/url]). For those of you who were running the [i]live_il2cpp[/i] branch you will need to revert back to [i]None[/i] to get the most up to date client built with IL2CPP tech.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed stuck spots in Newhaven Valley, Northreach, Dryfoot, Highland Hills, Redshore, Redshore Ridge, Grizzled Peaks, and Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Berserker Assault animations sometimes not playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed initialization issues with friend & guild lists + show offline button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with input fields locking character movement after a window was closed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added dithering effect to most vegetation when the camera is in close proximity.[/p][/*][*][p]Added arguments to the [i]/played[/i] command. You can now do "/played all" to show total played time for all characters on your account. In addition, you can specify another character on your account to get the played time for that specific character (i.e. "/played drindin"). Supplying no arguments (just [i]/played)[/i] will function as it did previously.[/p][/*][*][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]Added specific loading tips to some loading images regarding those images.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog when deploying a portable crafting station while missing your bag.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog when attempting to apply a consumable when that consumable's effect is already applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Escape now closes confirmation dialogs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Can Use" toggle to merchant windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat window:[/p][list][*][p]Revamped the saving & loading procedure for chat windows so that they are more reliable.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "/resetchatwindows" chat command to reset all chat windows to the default layout of 1x chat and 1x combat window in the bottom right of your screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Healing" filter to combat tabs.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: if you run into any issues we recommend running the above reset command for a fresh configuration.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Loot window:[/p][list][*][p]Added a Loot All button.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Loot All keybind (unbound by default).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Map window:[/p][list][*][p]Can now be resized to be slightly larger, or considerably smaller.[/p][/*][*][p]The aspect ratio of this window is locked to prevent scaling issues with the map. Keep in mind that this behavior is a bit different than other resizable windows (like the chat window).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Auction House [i]Buy It Now[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Now shows a reduced price when you are the current highest bidder. The total cost remains unchanged. However, if you are the highest bidder you can now pay the difference between your bid and the buy it now amount.[/p][/*][*][p]A "lower buy it now" indicator has been added when this is in effect - the tooltip shows the original price.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Design:[/p][list][*][p]Increased 3^ mob experience reward by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]Slowed respawn rate of Stonecoat + Drolsc camp in Grimstone Canyon.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased spawn chance for Blightroot and Deeproot Mandrakes/Mangroves within Blightroot Grove.[/p][/*][*][p]Stricter leashes on mobs within Shrieking Barrows to reduce the chances of 2^ mobs wandering into the 1^ loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased leash range on Freehold mobs that were resetting too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Most Smuggler camps in Newhaven Valley reduced to 1^ camps.[/p][/*][*][p]Wayward Mangrove path moved to the newbie area in NHV.[/p][/*][*][p]Mandrakes now spawn in the newbie area in NHV.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased threat for Knight's Bash, Marshal's Pressure & Sweep.[/p][/*][*][p]Warlord ability Despair alchemy versions now additional enhance the healing reduction debuff.[/p][/*][*][p]Quarterstaff of the Glacier stats changed to more Supporter focused stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Stags, Does, and Elks now have a chance to drop Tea leaves as loot (they still drop from skinning).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ibaxus:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue which was preventing Supporter Outer Armor from receiving haste from runes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing Mandrakes from being hostile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing set bonus on Greater Ibaxian inner armor Adornments.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the amount of Resin required for Ibaxian Adornment/Relic reconstruction.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cost of Resin.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced armor requirements for fighting in Central Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Ibaxian Shard drop counts.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased stat values provided by Greater Ibaxian Runes.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased armor on Inner Armor Adornments by a small amount.[/p][/*][*][p]Added stats to Defender Outer Armor Adornments. These continue the flavor of bonuses from GP1 armors.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more diversity to crab types.[/p][/*][*][p]Crabs in Ibaxus are now more social.[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Ibaxian Adornments/Relics now require a Shaped Ibaxian Adornment/Relic as part of the Artificing recipe. Note that the item is consumed in the process.[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Ibaxian Runes sell for slightly more than their lesser versions.[/p][/*][*][p]Ibaxian Ashen are now correctly resistant to Alchemy Effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Cor'duun Sentries no longer drop Runes or Artifacts.[/p][/*][*][p]Cor'duun now drop coin.[/p][/*][*][p]3^ mobs have an increased chance to drop runes and artifacts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]GEL Experience Adjustments[/h3][p]When you group with other players, our [b]Group Elevated Level (GEL)[/b] system helps lower-level players keep up with their higher-level group mates. GEL temporarily raises your effective combat level (up to +5 higher than your adventuring level) so that you can better land hits and contribute against more difficult enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]Previously, experience rewards while GEL'd were calculated based on your real level. This ultimately led to lower-level players getting poor experience returns when compared to other activities. With this month's update, experience rewards will now be calculated using your GEL level when comparing against the enemy's level. That means your experience gains will better match the challenge of what your group is fighting. Here is a practical example:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Before (old system):[/i][/p][list][*][p]Drindin (level 20) groups with Undone (level 26).[/p][/*][*][p]GEL raises Drindin's effective combat level to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]They defeat a level 27 NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin's is effective in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin experience reward is calculated based on a level delta of +7, which results in diminished experience as if the NPC was level 17 (light blue). (note that experience for level deltas of +3/+4/+5/... is diminished)[/p][/*][/list][p][i]After (new system):[/i][/p][list][*][p]Same scenario: Drindin (level 20) + Undone (level 26).[/p][/*][*][p]GEL raises Drindin's effective combat level to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]They defeat a level 27 NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin is still effective in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin's experience reward is calculated based on a level delta of +2, which results in non-diminished experience as if the NPC was level 22 (yellow).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We fully recognize that this doesn't solve all of our problems, but we believe it is a step in the right direction. It is also worth noting that while this is not exactly a "catch up" mechanic, lower level players should progress through their level at a faster pace than their higher level group mates. This is because higher levels require more kills to progress when compared to lower levels.[/p][p][/p][h3]Next Month[/h3][p]We're working hard on revamping the new player experience for next month's patch. The plan is to start players off with a specialization and allow them to acquire their Ember Stone + Alchemy at level 6. Please stay tuned as we will need some heavy QA testing. [/p][p]Also note that next month's patch will come a week earlier on September 23rd![/p]

This should make it easier to see for ranged attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Now properly renders with dynamic resolution modes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ibaxus:[/p][list][*][p]Improved notification of mobs calling allies from great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased delay for certain mobs calling allies from great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased variability in Stalker respawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Enforced stricter reset distances for some mobs.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted a number of nav links around the lake to reduce mobs from climbing the rocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Archibald no longer accepts money from your bank.[/p][/*][*][p]Shards no longer ask for confirmation during Need/Greed loot rolls.[/p][/*][*][p]With the recent slew of activity in Ibaxus the path from the Ember Ring to the valley has become well travelled.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Renamed a few reagents to reserve the "Potent" adjective for the highest level reagent item category:[/p][list][*][p]Potent Venom -> Strong Venom[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Ichor -> Concentrated Ichor[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Salve -> Soothing Salve[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Tincture -> Concentrated Tincture[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]MacOS builds are no longer universal binaries and will only work on Apple Silicon.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the default max shadow casting lights option to 2 (performance optimization).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Optimizations[/h2][h3]Engine and Shader Updates[/h3][p]This patch includes a Unity Engine update to the latest subversion. This brings some small performance improvements and bug fixes. In addition, all vegetation and custom shaders have been updated which should also yield some minor performance gains.[/p][p][/p][h3]Terrain Rendering Optimizations[/h3][p]This month we are adding new culling tech to overland scenes. Most zones are composed of 4 large terrains in a 2x2 configuration. Each individual terrain has a performance setting that was previously set to a fixed number. With this patch we are now dynamically adjusting this value based on your distance to each individual terrain - which should provide a small break to your GPU.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, we have enabled stochastic texture sampling in terrain shaders for all outdoor zones. This rendering technique should reduce the frequency of repeated texture patterns.[/p][p][/p][h3]Application Startup Optimizations[/h3][p]The last few patches have ballooned our application load times to an unacceptable level. On application start we are pre-loading a lot of data which can cause the client to show as "not responding". To mitigate this issue we have deferred some loading until the first loading screen is shown. This means that your first "zone in" after application startup may take slightly longer than it did previously, but subsequent zone loads will be quicker.[/p][p][/p][h3]UI Performance Optimizations[/h3][p]During a deep dive into performance of the game we identified an an issue with how our UI windows interact with Unity's backend UGUI system.[/p][p]Previously, all hidden windows have an alpha value of 0 and are not raycasted against, which means that they cannot be seen or interacted with. When a window is shown, we transition the alpha from 0->1 for a fade in, and enable racyasting for interactions. As it turns out, even though a UI element is not being rendered or raycasted against we were still paying a performance overhead in UGUI to keep them registered and available.[/p][p]This patch changes how we handle hidden windows within our UI system. Once hidden, a window's game object is now completely [i]disabled[/i] which removes them from the UIGUI system entirely. The downside to this, is that there is a slight performance hit for disabling and enabling objects (which is why we did not do it previously). However, this performance hit only lasts a single frame on open/close rather than us paying for having it registered with UGUI on [i]every[/i] frame.[/p][p]We have done a fair bit of internal testing and everything appears to work as usual. In theory this change should not even be noticed - outside of the performance improvement. On average I was saving upwards of 4ms per frame which isn't a giant leap forward, but it just may be enough to make a difference for you.[/p][p][/p][h3]IL2CPP Branch[/h3][p]To further improve performance, we have built an alternate client using Unity's IL2CPP build process, which converts the game into a native binary. In theory, this should provide significant performance gains. In practice, however, the results can vary considerably depending on several factors - most notably vegetation and point light shadows.[/p][p]Earlier this month we deployed a QA build using this tech but did not get enough feedback for us to make a call on if we should move forward with this tech as the primary build. We would ask that you try playing with the alternate IL2CPP build this month and report any issues you might encounter. If something game breaking comes up you can always swap back to the default branch.[/p][p][/p][p]To swap to this branch right click on Embers Adrift in your Steam library and select "Properties":[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/ac905ccea80bc9cf88260acfb526998d01870d54.png"][/img][/p][p]Next select "Betas" in the left hand column and you should see a menu on the right named "Beta Participation". In this dropdown you should see an entry called "live_il2cpp - experimental IL2CPP builds" - select this and you are good to go![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/ccc8594450b5ef27a45af1d221202c9fdbfca0aa.png"][/img][/p][p]To swap back to non-IL2CPP builds simply change this dropdown to "None". And just to reiterate - our goal is to make the default IL2CPP so any and all feedback you can provide on these builds would be extremely helpful.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Note that this is a LIVE build -meaning that this branch connects to the LIVE server.[/i][/p]

notes.title: The Lost City of Ibaxus
notes.notes: [p]This is our largest patch yet, introducing a brand-new level 50 group and raid zone: [i]The Lost City of Ibaxus[/i]. We've taken everything we've learned up to this point—lessons from past zones, systems, and player feedback—and poured it into the design of Ibaxus. With many new features built specifically for this zone and a wealth of content to explore, this update delivers hundreds of hours of additional gameplay for max level players.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed nameplate height inconsistencies for Stonecoats and Nocturnes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue with loot rolls not triggering in a raid.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "()" being shown on Need/Greed/Pass button tooltips if the action is not bound to a key.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a floating brick in Meadowlands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing portrait on Ageta.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a display issue with remaining sub time for new purchases who have also purchased subscription time.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted 3^ spawns near the Highland Hills Ember Vein solo loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Ember Essence can now be tracked on your action bar in place of experience. Right clicking the bubble has a new option "Ember Essence" if you have an Ember Stone.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new tell audio clip selectable in the options called "Notification".[/p][/*][*][p]Minor shadow optimizations in some dungeon rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the transparency of loot rolls.[/p][/*][*][p]Include "Stronghold" or "Drybone" in the names of lockbox keys to more easily differentiate the two.[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped the player stat panel:[/p][list][*][p]Improved visuals with better titles and spacing.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Negative haste is now calculated and displayed correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon augments are now included on your stat sheet (main hand only).[/p][/*][*][p]Holding ALT will break stats into Equipped / Augments / Effects in the tooltip.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2]The Lost City of Ibaxus[/h2][p]The lost city of Ibaxus has been discovered—carefully guarded by a faction of Others calling themselves Sages, who command their Cor’duun puppets. To gain entry to these hallowed grounds, you must find a way to attune yourself to the [i]Gate of Sages[/i], a powerful ward that repels all unworthy "Ibaxi'duun".[/p][p]Ibaxus lies in the highest reaches of the Grizzled Peaks—a breathtaking but treacherous ruin. Though it was their second home, it was the first city built entirely through the use of Alchemy by the Vehueramen people of old. It is said that the earliest whispers of their destruction were heard here, in the very city where Ibax himself once lived and breathed.[/p][p]Ibaxus is the most perilous region ever discovered by Drifters. Those who dare to explore its sacred grounds in search of lost knowledge and forgotten treasures should proceed with caution—and never drift alone.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/6d33c6fe26d4a136e15ff7c5fb4ab31e77d3a0e1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]To preserve the thrill of discovery, we won’t reveal too much—but here are some highlights of what you can expect from Ibaxus:[/p][list][*][p]Must complete the new quest [i]Gate of Sages[/i] to gain entry (requires a level 50 adventurer that has also completed the [i]The Cor'duun Heresy [/i]quest).[/p][/*][*][p]New challenging group and raid content with overlapping progression paths. Whether you're a dedicated group or part of a guild logging in just for the big encounters, both play styles can progress their characters in meaningful ways.[/p][list][*][p]Multiple tiers of progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Two distinct areas containing multiple bosses and mini-bosses.[/p][/*][*][p]Custom Hunting Logs that apply to entire groups of creatures from the different areas rather than being specific that a single creature type. NPC titles are used to indicate which region the creature comes from, and hence which Hunting Log entry they progress.[/p][/*][*][p]New equipment progression paths (see [i]Artificing[/i] below)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Inhabitants of Ibaxus spawn at levels greater than 50 and use a new stat rating system to increase their power against players. [/p][list][*][p]The previously imposed resistances to yellow & red mobs are not active for creatures 51+.[/p][/*][*][p]Your effectiveness against these creatures can be viewed in your stat window: either in each stat's tooltip or by changing the value of the +0/+1/+2/+3 dropdown that becomes visible in the stats UI once your character hits max level.[/p][/*][*][p]A new [i]Threat Modifier[/i] stat which allows for Defenders to generate more threat while allowing Supporters to generate less.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Ember Essence reward tech allow for certain mobs to grant Ember Essence to raids. All Ashen within Ibaxus use this tech as well as our old friend Todee.[/p][/*][*][p]New Ibaxian crafting profession [i]Artificing[/i] made available upon the completion of a new quest [i]Forged in Time[/i].[/p][list][*][p]Does not count against a character's profession count. This means it is available to ALL players who complete the quest. No previous crafting experience is required.[/p][/*][*][p]Provides a new level of freedom regarding stat selection for your equipment.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New crafting recipes to supplement [i]Artificing[/i] for Outfitter, Tinkerer, Weaponsmith, Woodworker, Armorsmith, and Provisioner upon the completion of a new quest [i]Reclaiming Forgotten Crafts [/i](requires a crafting profession to level 50)[i].[/i][/p][/*][*][p]New weapon visuals with unique colors for each specialization.[/p][/*][*][p]New equipment layering system that allows the player to layer items on top of their existing equipment in the form of Adornments. [/p][list][*][p]Adornments have no armor weight and grant stats like typical equipment. However, their stats are only granted within specific zones (i.e. Ibaxian Adornments are only [i]active[/i] within Ibaxus).[/p][/*][*][p]Adornments can also have set bonuses associated with them (which are also only in effect within their specific zones).[/p][/*][*][p]A good chunk of the equipment progression in Ibaxus focuses on these Adornments, which means that all of your efforts toward gaining the best items has not gone to waste and getting base upgrades will continue to play an important role.[/p][/*][*][p]Adornment visuals override your base equipment visuals, even when outside of the specific zone they are active in. The only exception to this is the cosmetic slot, which will always take precedence. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New deadly foes![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/f2cd2ca1940b1b64055a82d8f98feeccdca54810.png"][/img][/p][p]It is also worth noting that we aren't done yet; additional regions will be added to Ibaxus in the future![/p]

notes.notes:
[p]Greetings Drifters,   [/p][p]    Stormhaven Studios has completed the migration of Embers Adrift to the Steam platform which will fully launch on June 24th, 2025. We are happy to announce that we will be launching a new level 50 zone alongside our Steam launch, and running a 50% off sale on the game purchase and the wonderful game soundtrack from June 24th throughout the Steam Summer Sale ending July 10th. You can find our store page here: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3336530/Embers_Adrift/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]    If you are a returning player please follow these instructions to connect your current Embers Adrift account to your Steam account in order to download and play the game via Steam: [/p][p][url="https://forums.embersadrift.com/index.php?threads/steam-keys-and-account-linking.5981/"]https://forums.embersadrift.com/index.php?threads/steam-keys-and-account-linking.5981/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]    As many of you may know, we’ve had a rough past year that saw our team shrink or dev hours reduced and where we chose to offer Embers Adrift and its subscriber perks for free up until May 2025 due to the Digital River debacle (read our press release here: [url="https://forums.embersadrift.com/index.php?threads/stormhaven-studios-press-release-10-29-24.4710/"]https://forums.embersadrift.com/index.php?threads/stormhaven-studios-press-release-10-29-24.4710/[/url]). During that time we received zero revenue, but were helped by generous donations from the community which allowed us to keep the lights on. notes.title: Monthly Patch: May 2025
notes.notes:
This month’s update introduces a range of improvements, bug fixes, and technical enhancements. NPC abilities have been upgraded with new visual effects, giving players clearer cues to interrupt or evade attacks during encounters. Additionally, the game engine has been updated to Unity 6, which has allowed us to enhance performance and expand dynamic resolution options, ensuring smoother visuals and better optimization across various systems.

[i]It should also be noted that with this patch we are officially deprecating the legacy launcher. Thank you legacy launcher. You served us well; may you rest in peace.[/i]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a potential exception when sorting the guild list.
[*]Fixed a potential exception when retrieving the most recent chat tab.
[*]Fixed auction house level slider not working correctly for recipes.
[*]Fixed portrait context menu not being available while missing your bag.
[*]Fixed missing portrait for Verika NPC.
[*]Fixed missing portrait for Wicked Jack NPC.
[*]Fixed timeout at character select taking you back to legacy login.
[*]Fixed Hallows from floating apart in some zones.
[*]Fixed framerate limiter not being respected after changing quality settings.
[*]Fixed dropped Radiant Fluxes not stacking with crafted ones.
[*]Fixed zoom in/out keybinds working while chatting.
[*]Fixed stairs in Forgotten Depths from not receiving target reticle decals.
[*]Fixed AC value on some low level gloves.
[*]Fixed the reset button position for the control panel (upper right).
[*]Fixed typo on Flasks of Viscous Tar.
[*]Fixed issues with mismatched time remaining for subscription tooltips and UI elements.
[*]Fixed crafted crab meat missing the "seasoned" prefix
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Resource nodes now have abbreviated overhead names.
[*]Ability line-of-sight checks are now cached to avoid multiple identical raycasts per frame.
[*]Added the "/discord" chat command to open our Discord invite link.
[*]Added basic armor and weapons to Newhaven Valley merchants.
[*]Added a search field to the crafting window.
[*]Added loading screen tip "If you are having trouble with ranged NPCs try breaking line of sight".
[*]Wolves may now howl.
[*]Increased Flatworm collider radius by 70%. This "should" make them a bit easier to catch. If they continue to be a problem however, let us know and we will re-work the detection methods in a future patch.
[*]Warden ability Venom Shock: updated the alchemy tooltip text description to be named "Ember Shock" and that it deals Ember damage specifically with alchemy. 
[/list]

[h2]NPC Execution Visibility Improvements[/h2]
To improve the visibility of NPC ability executions we have started to add corresponding visual effects. This first pass touches all control-based effects (Confuse, Root, Snare, Stun, Daze) which should make it easier to interrupt pesky NPCs with a non-resisted Stun, Daze, or Fear. A number of these abilities will also use new unique animations.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gsdYlYl.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2IkAJO6.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SsMv57G.gif[/img]

We will continue to add NPC VFX where appropriate in future patches. In the mean time, feedback on the current implementations is welcome!

[h2]Engine Upgrade to Unity 6[/h2]
Both the game client and server are now running on Unity 6. This update brings performance improvements, bug fixes, and makes a number of new tech tools available.

The first new tech we are utilizing is a revamp of the dynamic resolution options available in our graphics settings. Previously, we offered a "Resolution Scale" slider (which was AMD's-FSR1), and DLSS for those with supported Nvidia cards. We are now able to offer the following three options:
[list]
[*][b]STP[/b] (Spatial-Temporal Post-Processing): this is Unity's platform agnostic frame-gen solution that works on Windows, MacOS, and Linux with any current hardware.
[*][b]FSR2[/b] (AMD's FidelityFX Super Resolution 2): this is AMD's frame-gen solution that works on Windows and does NOT require an AMD graphics card.
[*][b]DLSS[/b] (Nvidia's Deep Learning Super Sampling): this is Nvidia's frame-gen solution that works on Windows with compatible Nvidia hardware.
[/list]
Each has a quality dropdown which allows you adjust the upscaling towards higher image quality or faster performance. Each technique offers something a little different and performance benefits will vary from machine to machine. We encourage you to tinker with these settings to find what best works for you.

In addition to the above changes, Unity 6 should yield slightly better performance all around. More new tools we will be investigating in the coming weeks to further improve performance.

[h2]Payment Issues Update[/h2]
As mentioned in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3336530/view/510707115067703902]this post[/url], we are continuing to work with Steam to resolve back-end issues related to subscription payments. However, due to the ongoing delays, we’ve decided to transition away from monthly subscriptions and instead offer blocks of perk time for purchase. This change will give us greater control and allow us to address any future issues more quickly and efficiently.

When this new system goes live, any un-refunded subscription payments will be converted into equivalent game time. This change requires some development work. In the meantime, we will continue to provide free subscription perks to all users who log in through Steam.

notes.title: Unity 6 lands on the testing server!
notes.notes:
After hours of reimporting textures, compiling shaders, and working through errors we finally have Unity 6 clients ready for testing! Engine upgrades are always a pain in the neck and typically introduce random bugs; that is where you come in!

First you will need to switch Embers Adrift on steam to the "development" branch. This can be done by right clicking on Embers Adrift in your Steam library -> Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation dropdown select "development". 

[i]Note that this will patch your game to the latest QA client - and in this particular case download is a decent size due to the engine upgrade (many files have changed). Once live and dev are on the same engine version then this difference will typically be much smaller. To swap back to live you follow the same procedure outlined above but select "None" in the betas dropdown.[/i]


[h3]Changes[/h3]
This is primarily a technical update and requires testing of all gameplay elements to validate that everything works as it did previously. However, this upgrade provides us with a few new tools that we have started to experiment with. 

The first change we are testing is a revamp of the dynamic resolution options available in graphics settings. Previously, we offered a "Resolution Scale" slider (which was AMD's-FSR1), and DLSS for those with supported Nvidia cards. We are now able to offer the following three options:
[list]
[*][b]STP[/b] (Spatial-Temporal Post-Processing): this is Unity's platform agnostic frame-gen solution that works on Windows, MacOS, and Linux with any current hardware.
[*][b]FSR2[/b] (AMD's FidelityFX Super Resolution 2): this is AMD's frame-gen solution that works on Windows and does NOT require an AMD graphics card.
[*][b]DLSS[/b] (Nvidia's Deep Learning Super Sampling): this is Nvidia's frame-gen solution that works on Windows with compatible Nvidia hardware.
[/list]
Each has a quality dropdown which allows you adjust the upscaling towards higher image quality or faster performance.

We are considering enabling STP by default for new players to smooth things out and make a better first impression - but we need to hear from you all first! How does STP run on your machine? How does STP compare to FSR2 and DLSS? Do you think that we should enable STP by default for new players? Please join the discord and drop us a line in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/168028734039916544/1075841004449579128]#qa channel [/url]with your thoughts and experience!

In addition to the above changes Unity 6 [i]should[/i] yield slightly better performance all around. There are some additional new tools in Unity 6 that we will be investigating in the coming weeks to improve performance further.

We have some fun content and features planned for this month so stay tuned for further updates! And no, it's not GP2 yet (although we are getting much closer!).

[i][strike]NOTE that Unity 6 builds currently only exist for Windows & MacOS. Linux is running a little behind but hopefully will be ready soon.[/strike] 
A Unity 6 Linux build should be available now!
[/i]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/200be374fd12a5b8fbccb567279eb4744cc9801d.jpg[/img]
This will show a modal popup with a button to "Link My Forum Account"
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/77c21e45a4209747ac71ff2195e5e98a67ad550b.jpg[/img]
Clicking this button will take you to [url=https://forums.embersadrift.com/index.php?threads/steam-keys-and-account-linking.5981/#:~:text=your%20forum%20account%20preferences%20%22Connected%20Accounts%22%20option]your forum account preferences "Connected Accounts" option[/url].
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/91d86acc69bb0d845bab016bf6af021001724f09.jpg[/img]
Click the "Associate with Steam" button which will take you to the following Steam webpage
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/874952f8c828b2abfd09126b250563bf1115f716.png[/img]
Sign in here to associate your Steam ID to your forum account. Our back-end needs this information for the next step.

[h2]Step 2: Permanently link your EmbersAdrift account to your Steam Account[/h2]
Return to your account page and once again click the "Link My Forum Account" button mentioned above. You should be shown the new modal:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/be1ec26e71f745a07797ccb50f564bae90596cc8.jpg[/img]
Clicking the "Link My Embers Account" will establish a permanent link for the associated Steam ID to your EmbersAdrift forum account. This step allows you to access your forum-account characters with your Steam credentials.

[h2]Step 3: Redeem your Steam key (if you have previously purchased the game on EmbersAdrift.com)[/h2]
If you have previously purchased the game your account should now show the following
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/adddb55b20bc3b4b5aa7addd63842d8ab4bd8bd5.jpg[/img]
Clicking "Redeem Steam Key" you should get a new modal
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/97a188e8ec550f5b5b0ceafa64cb4bb745709bc1.jpg[/img]
Which has a "Redeem on Steam" button to add Embers Adrift to your Steam Library.

[h2]Step 4: Launch the game and login with Steam[/h2]
When launching the game through steam you will be presented with two login options: Steam Login, and Legacy Login
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/b357f63f93dee9b27048c795db418d35d7c408ee.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Steam Login: logs in with your Steam credentials and allows you to purchase a subscription.
[*]Legacy Login: allows you to continue to use your forum username & password. Using this method will not provide any subscriber perks and has been left in place to allow those with multiple accounts to access those characters. Keep in mind that non-subscriber accounts only allow for two active characters. To gain subscriber perks on a secondary account you will need a second Steam account to purchase a subscription.
[/list]
Logging in via Steam will bypass the need for any username/password and instead will use your SteamID to validate ownership and subscription status:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45320885/6f3250ab52699cf8be16769805bb70aabe46d80a.jpg[/img]
